name: Aaj Ka Shabd
tagline: A little hint. A new word. A daily discovery.
description: Guess the Hindi word using clues and colour hints.
howToPlay: Read the clue and fill five boxes using the on-screen letter groups. Tap Check, then use green, yellow, and grey feedback to improve your next guess. Find the word within six attempts.
screenshots: Solved word, meaning and related story

name: Aaj Ki Niti
tagline: Complete a thought. Carry it into your day.
description: Complete a thoughtful phrase and share its personalised card.
howToPlay: Read the unfinished thought, choose one of four answers, and check your choice. Read the completed thought and its meaning. Add a name to its card, then download or share it if you like.

name: Aaj Ka Over
tagline: Six balls. One challenge. Your moment.
description: Chase or defend a cricket target in six balls.
howToPlay: Pick a team and choose batting or bowling. When batting, swipe toward your shot as the ball reaches the green timing mark. When bowling, choose a spot on the pitch and release. Chase or defend the target within six balls; two wickets end the innings.
screenshots: Front screen · team and role selection

name: Aaj Ka Nishana
tagline: A familiar board. A fresh target.
description: Aim, strike, and pocket coins in a Carrom challenge.
howToPlay: Read the target above the board. Move the striker along the bottom line, pull back to aim and set power, then release. Keep taking shots until you complete the target; every shot counts.

name: Aaj Ki Jodi
tagline: Find the pairs. Discover the bigger picture.
description: Match related facts and discover the connections behind them.
howToPlay: Read both columns and tap one card, then its related partner in the other column. You can also drag a line between them. Match all four pairs, then explore the explanations and related stories.
